## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (or CI is green)
- [ ] Database change? It ships as a **new** numbered migration; applied ones are never edited
- [ ] Touches the API? Validation and auth are covered (a test or a smoke-test check)
- [ ] User-visible text exists in both English and Arabic
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
